main.description: A Visual Studio Code extension showing remaining 5-hour and weekly quota for the Codex CLI account on the machine where it is installed.
main.trust: Quota queries execute Codex CLI on the machine running this extension.
togglePosition: Codex Quota: Switch status bar side
showAccount: Codex Quota: View account and quota source
statusBarPosition: Status bar side. Changes apply immediately.
cliPath: Codex executable path (or official npm JS entry) on the machine running this extension. Use local user settings locally and remote user settings remotely; shell commands are not accepted.
codexHome: Codex configuration directory on this machine. Leave empty to inherit its CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Supports ~/. Credentials are not read by this extension.
remoteCliPath: Codex CLI path on the remote host. Configure in remote user settings; shell commands are not accepted.
remoteCodexHome: Codex configuration directory on the remote host. Leave empty to inherit remote CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Supports ~/.
requestTimeoutSeconds: Timeout for the entire quota query in seconds.
language: Display language for the extension menus, status bar, tooltips and errors. Changes apply immediately.
language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
showPublicIp: Show this extension host’s public outbound IP using HTTPS ipify. Cached for five minutes; failure does not prevent quota queries.
remoteCliPath.deprecated: Use codexQuota.cliPath in remote user settings. This legacy value is used only if the new setting is unset.
remoteCodexHome.deprecated: Use codexQuota.codexHome in remote user settings. This legacy value is used only if the new setting is unset.
